User Story Description: As a user, I want the app to require valid credentials, so that protected content is restricted.
As a user, I want invalid credentials rejected, so that unauthorized access is prevented.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid credentials show an inline error

User Story Description: As a signed-in user, I want logout to clear protected state, so that my session cannot continue.
Acceptance Criteria: Logout hides the app and resets password input

User Story Description: As a commuter, I want to select a location and see live weather, so that I can plan footwear.
As a commuter, I want Bike/Cycle/Car filtering, so that my shoe choice fits the route.
Acceptance Criteria: Each commute produces weather and terrain matches

User Story Description: As a shopper, I want to browse 40 unique shoes with UK size 8, so that I can compare options.
As a shopper, I want brand counts and brand filtering, so that I can navigate the catalogue.
Acceptance Criteria: 15 brands are listed and brand filters show matching models

User Story Description: As a shopper, I want details, variants, pros and cons, so that I can assess a shoe.
Acceptance Criteria: Details show description, fit, weather, terrain and variants

User Story Description: As a runner, I want distance and running type filtering, so that shoes match my run.
Preconditions: Location weather and distance are selected
Acceptance Criteria: Running range 1-42 km and seven running types are available

User Story Description: As an administrator, I want unverified images excluded and access protected, so that licensing is respected.
Acceptance Criteria: Public API returns only verified images; protected API requires a bearer token

User Story Description: As a user, I want clear failures and loading states, so that I understand unavailable integrations.
Acceptance Criteria: Geocoding/weather failures show actionable status text
